_format.note: Item definitions. Spawned in rooms by map.js based on archetype item_chance and item-specific spawn rules.
_format.spawn: Each item has a 'spawn' field describing where it can appear: 'any' (any item-allowing room), 'records' (records room only), 'office' (office only), 'supply' (supply closet only), 'attending_office' (attending's office only), 'ward' (patient room only).
_format.effect: When TAKEn, the item enters inventory. Effects fire when relevant (e.g., key is consumed when used on a locked door). Documents fire READ effects.

exit_chart.name: duty roster
exit_chart.prose: A duty roster from before the staff left. ~~Pinned to a folder marked CLOSURE.~~ One door is circled in red. The door marked: {exit_name}.

schedule.name: the schedule
schedule.prose: The Attending's rounds. The page is dated for the **current week**. There is a route, an hour, and a column titled DEVIATIONS that has been filled in with names.

disguise.name: staff coat
disguise.prose: A staff coat hanging on a hook. The name tag has been pulled off. ~~The pocket has~~ A pocket contains a pen.

sedative.name: single-use sedative
sedative.prose: A small foil packet. Contents will let you skip the next time the Attending notes you. They will note that you are sleeping.

key_north.name: front entrance key
key_north.prose: A small brass key. Tagged: FRONT.

key_east.name: service key
key_east.prose: A worn brass key. Tagged: E-SERV.

your_file_fragment.name: a fragment of your file
your_file_fragment.prose: A torn page from the file labelled 0413. *Subject was admitted on the night of ~~the [[3]] of [[8]]~~ — the date has been removed. Subject had no identification. Subject signed the intake.* Below: a signature. *It is yours.*

second_chart.name: an old roster
second_chart.prose: A roster from an earlier week. Some names have been ~~discharged~~ struck through. Some names you have seen on doors tonight.

chapel_card.name: prayer card
chapel_card.prose: A small printed card from the chapel. *In the hour of trial, the gate stands open ~~to those who walked in~~ to those who can find it.*
